name: kweli-single-place-agent
description: The single place generator — creates exactly one named place on request (vs. bulk-place-agent's area-based seeding): resolves coordinates (direct or geocoded), checks OSM for an existing match, and writes a tier-0 place + entity via @kweli-mcp/skills. Independent of the Kweli MCP: exposes its own public POST /tasks, WorkOS M2M gated (no org restriction), so any Nyuchi/Mukoko app can call it directly.
